svg.text: GLYPH / DESIGN THE BONES, THEN GROW THE INK
One shared DNA / two original authored sources / fixed canvas and color
Teal: redesigned centerlines; junctions attach to the main bar
Bone rules: angle, length, bend, position. Ink rules: width distribution, bulge position, side bias, caps.
Only explicit maps for this character. Width/taper inheritance is adjustable; source serifs and arbitrary fonts are not reproduced.
